column3: “Its rider held” renders “the one sitting on it having”; “to overcome and conquer” renders “overcoming and that he may conquer.”
“Was granted permission” renders “was given”; “to make men slay one another” recasts “that they will slay one another.”
“A quart” and “three quarts” render χοῖνιξ (“choenix”), a dry measure.
“Pale green” renders χλωρὸς (“greenish-pale”); “close behind” is added.
BSB adds “the Lamb” and has no “of the Lamb” (ἀρνίου) after “testimony.”
“Until You avenge our blood and judge” reverses and recasts “do You not judge and avenge our blood.”
“The full number of their fellow servants … were killed” recasts “until their fellow servants and their brothers may be fulfilled, who are about to be killed.”
BSB adds “the Lamb”; “goat hair” renders τρίχινος (“of hair”); “turned blood red” renders “became like blood.”
“Like unripe figs dropping from a tree” recasts “as a fig tree casts its unripe figs.”
BSB follows the critical-text order “commanders, the rich” and has “every slave and free man” (the Textus Receptus repeats “every”).
BSB follows the critical text with “Their wrath” (the Textus Receptus has “His”). “Withstand it” renders “stand.”
